title: Take a tour of this impressive five bedroom £775k family home in the city centre
text: Take a tour of this impressive five bedroom £775k family home in the city centre It sits in an exclusive development A five-bedroom detached home which has been completely remodelled and modernised by its present owners has gone on the market for £775,000. The property stands on Pavilion Way, an exclusive development of executive-style houses just off Trent Bridge Way on the outskirts of Wakefield city centre. Its accommodation is arranged across two floors, beginning with an entrance porch and spacious hallway on the ground floor. There is a lounge and dining room with a feature media wall, as well as a separate TV room. A fitted kitchen, dining and family room provides further living space, while the floor also includes a utility room and guest w.c. On the first floor, the landing incorporates a study or dressing area with a Juliette balcony.The home's five good-sized bedrooms are served by three luxury bathrooms, including two en suites. Outside, the property has a low-maintenance enclosed rear garden, a double-width garage and off-street parking. The home is ideally placed for local schools, shops and transport amenities, with motorway links nearby.

The property stands on Pavilion Way, an exclusive development of executive-style houses just off Trent Bridge Way on the outskirts of Wakefield city centre.
